project_name: ITHelpdesk & Inventory Platform - Alex IT Support
app_type: dashboard / internal IT helpdesk SaaS app
language: French (UI & labels strictly in French as requested: 'Clair et épuré, style corporate bleu')
emotional_tone: Trustworthy, hyper-efficient, crisp corporate helpdesk, calm precision

headings.font_family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif
headings.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
headings.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

login_screen.description: Simplified instant ID-based login for quick access (no password needed as requested). Includes one-click quick switch employee/admin avatars (Alex - Tech IT Admin, Sam - Tech IT Admin, Marie - Commercial, Lucas - Logistique, Sophie - RH) and manual ID input.
login_screen.visual: Centered light-blue floating card with crisp shadow-sm, corporate IT badge icon, recent user chips for quick test logins.

header_navigation.description: Sticky top bar containing the app title 'Alex & Co IT Helpdesk & Stock', current user badge with role indicator ('Support Tech Admin' or 'Employé'), Quick ID Switcher, Quick Ticket CTA button, and system health status dot.
header_navigation.classes: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 px-6 flex items-center justify-between

sidebar_navigation.description: Left sidebar navigation with tab items matching user role: Employee sees 'Mes Tickets', 'Nouveau Ticket', 'Mon Profil'; Admin sees 'Tableau de Bord', 'Tous les Tickets', 'Gestion du Stock', 'Alertes & Rappels Date', 'Logs de Connexion'.
sidebar_navigation.responsive: Collapsible to icon rail or slide-over menu on mobile.

dashboard_grid.kpi_strip: 4-column grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6) with metrics: Tickets Ouverts, Stock en Alerte, Delai Moyen de Résolution, Connexions Aujourd'hui.
dashboard_grid.main_section: 2-column grid (lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6) where Col-span-2 holds Ticket Table / Stock Table and Col-span-1 holds Real-time Alerts Panel & Connexion Logs feed.

login_by_id.requirement: Login strictly by Employee ID without password.

ticket_management.employee_view: Can view own tickets, see status timeline, submit new ticket modal with instant dropdown selection.
ticket_management.admin_view: Can filter all tickets by status/priority/category, search by keyword, assign ticket to Alex or Sam, update status, write resolution notes.

inventory_stock_management.alert_system: Automatic visual alert highlight (badge + warning banner) when quantity <= min_threshold or when expiration/maintenance date is within 7 days.
inventory_stock_management.actions: Add new item, quick +1/-1 quantity buttons, edit item, delete item, filter low stock items, date filter.

date_alerts_reminders.description: Stock & maintenance alert reminders sorted by date (e.g. printer maintenance due, software license renewal, warranty expiry, scheduled hardware audits).

employee_connection_logs.description: Real-time log table tracking every employee connection by ID.

visual_enhancers.card_style: Flat solid white container with 1px hairline border (`border-slate-200`), rounded-lg, shadow-sm hover:border-blue-300 transition-colors duration-200
visual_enhancers.badge_style: Pill badge with light background, matching 600 text color, and subtle 1px border. Status dot indicator inside.
visual_enhancers.table_style: High-density clean table with light slate header (`bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider`), hover row highlight (`hover:bg-slate-50/80`), and explicit cell padding (`py-3.5 px-4`).
visual_enhancers.interactive_feedback: Hover scale buttons (`hover:bg-blue-700 active:scale-[0.98]`), focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none`), and toast alerts using Sonner.

image_urls.description: IT Support Technician working at dual screen workstation

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (inputs, buttons, select dropdown options, table rows, tab triggers, modal triggers) MUST contain clear kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-id-input', data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='create-ticket-button', data-testid='ticket-category-select', data-testid='stock-item-add-button', data-testid='stock-quick-add-EMP-001', data-testid='role-switcher-admin').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.npm_start_requirement: Ensure the application can be run seamlessly with 'npm start' or simple start scripts as requested by Alex. Keep backend/mock storage resilient with local storage persistence + initial pre-populated realistic data.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.hover_contrast_rule: Always explicitly define text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white). Never rely on default text color inheritance for active states.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.dropdown_background_rule: NEVER use transparent backgrounds on select dropdowns, popovers, or floating menus. Always use solid white bg (`bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-lg z-50`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.prepopulated_mock_data: Include rich initial data: 8+ tickets in various statuses/priorities, 12+ inventory items (with 3 items below threshold triggering alerts, e.g., 'Câbles HDMI 2m', 'Toners HP LaserJet', 'Souris Ergonomiques'), 10+ connection log entries, and 4 date-based reminders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for toasts upon ticket creation, ticket assignment, status updates, stock additions/adjustments, and log exports.
